description: Frozen single-source definitions (P00) for the 3D ISAW contact-motif analysis of PNIPAM. isaw_schema.py loads and validates this file and exposes deep-copied, immutable-by-convention definitions. Code-level constants in isaw_contact_observables.py MUST agree with the bin/graph definitions here (a test enforces this).

chain_length_convention.note: Every output file records both n_beads and n_steps to prevent off-by-one errors.

contact_definition.contact_indicator: Delta_ij = 1 when beads i and j occupy nearest-neighbour lattice sites and j - i > 1; else 0
contact_definition.counting_rule: each unordered nonbonded nearest-neighbour pair counted exactly once
contact_definition.parity_constraint: all valid contact contour separations r = j - i are odd on the simple cubic lattice

reduced_bias_definition: b(T) is the reduced contact bias; sampling weight P(C|T) ∝ exp[-m(C) b(T)].
K_definition: K(T) = -b(T); thus P(C|T) ∝ exp[K(T) m(C)] and HIGHER K FAVORS MORE CONTACTS.
q_definition: q(T) = exp(K(T)) = exp(-b(T)); K is authoritative because q can overflow.
effective_energy_definition: H(C,T) = T u(C,T); model-implied, NOT automatically a temperature-independent physical energy for polynomial effective models.

pnipam_lcst_expectations.note: PNIPAM collapses as temperature INCREASES over the fitted LCST range. Do not assume lower T is more collapsed. These trends MUST be checked against the fitted model, not hardcoded.
over_fitted_range: mean contact count m increases as T increases
long-range/global contacts and connected contact structure increase as collapse develops

bin_scheme_independence: The fixed and scaled schemes are INDEPENDENT; each is exhaustive and non-overlapping over the valid (odd, r>=3) separations within its own definition. m_r remains authoritative.

pair_motif_taxonomy.canonicalization: each contact sorted to (i, j) with i < j; result symmetric under swapping the two contacts
pair_motif_taxonomy.priority: shared_endpoint takes priority; with four distinct endpoints exactly one of disjoint/nested/interleaved applies
pair_motif_taxonomy.shared_endpoint: the two contacts share at least one bead index
pair_motif_taxonomy.exhaustiveness: sum over the four exclusive classes equals C(m,2)

contact_graph_definition.vertices: bead indices participating in at least one nonbonded contact
contact_graph_definition.S_max: largest_component_vertices; a finite-size structural indicator, not automatically a thermodynamic order parameter
contact_graph_definition.largest_component_tie_break: ties on vertex count broken by smallest minimum vertex index (deterministic)

augmented_graph_definition.edges: backbone edges (i,i+1) for i in 0..N-2 plus nonbonded contact edges
augmented_graph_definition.clustering_note: the simple-cubic contact graph is bipartite by odd-separation parity, so triangle clustering is structurally constrained and is intentionally omitted rather than reported as trivially near-zero

thermodynamic_feature_columns.q_T: q(T) = exp(K(T)); inf/null when it overflows
thermodynamic_feature_columns.effective_energy_H: H = T u (model-implied, not necessarily physical)

m_r_authority: m_r (dense contour-separation histogram, length n_beads) is authoritative. sum_r m_r == m; even entries zero.
